query.description: Reconciles the completed Run, result summary, normalized orders and trades.
query.sql: SELECT r.run_id, r.config_digest, r.dataset_digest, r.result_digest, res.summary_json FROM backtest.backtest_runs r JOIN backtest.backtest_results res USING (run_id) WHERE r.run_id = 'run-91ad87981676414da87b928398fa43c9';
metric_definitions: ENTRY fill rate = filled ENTRY orders / all ENTRY orders
Total return = (final equity - starting cash) / starting cash

query.description: Reconstructs raw prices from the frozen 5 bps per-side fill model and reconciles explicit costs to net P&L.
query.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT (payload_json->>'gross_pnl')::numeric post_slippage_gross, (payload_json->>'net_pnl')::numeric net_pnl, (payload_json->'entry'->>'price')::numeric entry_fill_price, (payload_json->'exit'->>'price')::numeric exit_fill_price, (payload_json->'entry'->>'shares')::numeric shares, (payload_json->'entry'->>'total_cost')::numeric + (payload_json->'exit'->>'total_cost')::numeric explicit_costs FROM backtest.backtest_trades WHERE run_id='run-91ad87981676414da87b928398fa43c9') SELECT SUM(((exit_fill_price/0.9995)-(entry_fill_price/1.0005))*shares) pre_slippage_gross, SUM(((exit_fill_price/0.9995)-(entry_fill_price/1.0005))*shares-post_slippage_gross) slippage_drag, SUM(explicit_costs) explicit_costs, SUM(net_pnl) net_pnl FROM t;
metric_definitions: Pre-slippage price P&L reverses the frozen 1.0005 ENTRY and 0.9995 EXIT multipliers
Explicit costs = entry commission + exit commission + sell tax

query.description: Ranks ENTRY orders within each session by created_at and symbol, then compares fill rates by mutually exclusive buckets.
query.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT jsonb_array_elements(payload_json) item FROM backtest.backtest_result_chunks WHERE run_id='run-91ad87981676414da87b928398fa43c9' AND field_name='orders'), e AS (SELECT (item->>'created_at')::timestamptz created_at, item->>'symbol' symbol, item->>'status' status FROM o WHERE item->>'side'='ENTRY'), r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date ORDER BY created_at,symbol) signal_rank FROM e) SELECT CASE WHEN signal_rank<=10 THEN '001-010' WHEN signal_rank<=20 THEN '011-020' WHEN signal_rank<=50 THEN '021-050' WHEN signal_rank<=100 THEN '051-100' ELSE '101+' END rank_bucket, COUNT(*) signals, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='FILLED') filled, AVG((status='FILLED')::integer) fill_rate FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
metric_definitions: Fill rate = filled orders / signals within each rank bucket

query.description: Aggregates trade-level net_pnl_pct by entry year so capital depletion does not masquerade as recovery.
query.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM entry_at::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::integer year, COUNT(*) trades, AVG(((payload_json->>'net_pnl')::numeric>0)::integer) win_rate, AVG((payload_json->>'net_pnl_pct')::numeric)/100 average_net_return, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload_json->>'net_pnl_pct')::numeric)/100 median_net_return FROM backtest.backtest_trades WHERE run_id='run-91ad87981676414da87b928398fa43c9' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
metric_definitions: Average net return is the average stored net_pnl_pct converted from percentage points to a fractional rate

query.description: Calculates the share of active trade days with positive aggregate net P&L.
query.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT (entry_at::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date session_date, SUM((payload_json->>'net_pnl')::numeric) net_pnl FROM backtest.backtest_trades WHERE run_id='run-91ad87981676414da87b928398fa43c9' GROUP BY 1) SELECT AVG((net_pnl>0)::integer) profitable_day_rate FROM d;
metric_definitions: Profitable-day rate = active trade days with aggregate net P&L > 0 / all active trade days

blocks.body:
## 研究契約更新（2026-08-25）

**SUPERSEDED NOTICE：**舊版報告使用的 `allocation-neutral control` 一詞已作廢。R5 的正確名稱是 **cash-admission-neutral sensitivity control**：它只排除剩餘現金不足造成的 admission bias，不宣稱 current-equity sizing、整張 rounding、order notional 或 P&L weighting 對 symbol order 完全中立。下列 baseline 數值與失敗歸因沒有改變；R5 尚未執行，也尚無可解讀的 control 績效。

## 技術結論：策略不可使用，但需先排除 cash-admission bias

這個 exact Strategy Set 應維持 **HOLD / NOT ELIGIBLE**。已成交樣本在 slippage 與交易稅費之前就虧損，成本再把虧損放大到幾乎歸零；但 95.09% ENTRY signals 因現金不足被拒絕，且成交機率強烈依賴同日 signal 排序。因此它證明目前組合不可用，尚不能視為 182 檔 VWAP signals 的無偏估計。下一步只應執行相同 Version、相同 EOD exit 與相同成本的 cash-admission-neutral sensitivity control；不得 promotion、Local Paper 或 broker execution。

## 成本是巨大放大器，但不是負 edge 的根因

由 frozen fill model 反推後，未計 slippage 的 price-path P&L 已是 **-1.37M**。5 bps/side slippage 再拖累 **1.24M**，commission 與 sell tax 再拖累 **7.26M**，累計成 **-9.87M** net P&L。這是 descriptive reconciliation，不是零成本反事實策略的正式回測；但足以否定「只要降低手續費就會獲利」的解釋。

## Shared cash 讓成交樣本偏向較早出現的 signals

Engine 依 `(timestamp, symbol)` 處理 bars，每個 candidate 以總權益 10% 計算部位，再以剩餘 cash admission。每日平均出現 **177.17** 個 ENTRY signals，卻只成交 **8.69** 個；同日 ranks 1-10 的 fill rate 是 **39.37%**，ranks 101+ 只剩 **0.73%**。這表示 baseline P&L 同時反映 signal 與排序／資金政策。

## 資金下降後，單筆報酬並沒有轉正

Raw TWD loss 在後期變小，是因為 equity 已大幅縮水。改用每筆 entry notional 正規化後，2023-2026 的平均與中位 net return 每年都為負；因此不能把 2025-2026 較小的金額虧損解讀成策略改善。

## 範圍、資料與指標定義

分析單位是 completed Run `run-91ad87981676414da87b928398fa43c9` 的 6,321 closed trades、128,802 ENTRY orders 與 727 daily-equity points。ENTRY 是 `above_vwap_entry` Version 1，參數為 09:01-12:45、minimum distance 0 bps；EXIT 固定為 EOD close。VWAP 使用 completed 1m close × volume proxy，不是真實 turnover。`net_pnl_pct` 是以該 trade entry notional 表示的百分點，報告轉為 fractional percent scale。

## 方法：只讀重建，不重跑與不調參

先核對 Run/config/Dataset/result/Version digests，再從 normalized trades 與 immutable chunks 重建 order outcomes、cost reconciliation、year/time/symbol cuts 與 rank buckets。Slippage 依 engine 的 ENTRY `raw × 1.0005`、EXIT `raw × 0.9995` 公式反推。所有 SQL 保存在 phase evidence pack；這一輪沒有建立新 Run、修改 Strategy Version 或更動 lifecycle。

## 限制與 robustness 邊界

本結果仍是 exploratory：Dataset 有 current-snapshot survivorship、partial universe、raw unadjusted prices、current non-PIT metadata 與 derived amount proxy。ENTRY 與 EOD EXIT 的獨立貢獻也無法由單一 Run 分離；MFE/MAE 或固定 horizon 需要另外做 5.5 GiB bar-path join。這些限制會阻擋 promotion，但不會把已觀測的負 P&L 變成正證據。

## 下一步：先做唯一的 cash-admission-neutral sensitivity control

R5 維持 exact VWAP Version、EOD exit、Dataset、engine 與成本；`starting_cash` 與 `position_fraction` 由 server 依 frozen preflight 公式確定性推導，操作者不能輸入或挑選。每個 baseline＋contract revision 只能有一個 sealed authoritative control。Server postflight 必須先確認 missing next bar 為 0、所有 ENTRY 全數 FILLED、所有 rejection reason 為 0，且 signal keys 以 multiplicity-aware parity 完全一致，才會曝光績效。若 pre-slippage P&L 仍不大於 0，停止調整這個策略，才進入其餘 7 個原子 ENTRY 的預先登記 benchmark matrix。任何結果都不會自動 promotion 或啟動模擬交易。

## 後續仍需回答

- Cash-admission-neutral sensitivity control 是否仍呈現負 pre-slippage edge？
- 若 price edge 為正、net edge 為負，虧損主要在哪個 holding horizon 被成本吃掉？
- 相同 execution protocol 下，哪一個單一原子 ENTRY 能先通過 exploratory screening？
- 何時可取得 research-eligible、adjusted-price、point-in-time Dataset 做正式 Qualification？

causes.evidence: Fill rate 39.37% at ranks 1-10 vs 0.73% at ranks 101+
causes.decision: Require one sealed cash-admission-neutral sensitivity control
Keep realistic costs in all controls
Do not tune on the same Run
